Who it is for / Hair styling

Business management software for hair salons in Nigeria.

Relynked runs your hair salon from one place: your services and prices, how long each one takes, your staff, your customers, and your bookings. Remy, the assistant inside Relynked, answers your customers on WhatsApp and books them a time, and the day's bookings are waiting for you in the app.
